shortDescription: Create or destroy a K8s Cluster.

options.name: api_subnet_allow_list
options.description: Access to the K8s API server is restricted to these CIDRs. Intra-cluster traffic is not affected by this restriction. If no AllowList is specified, access is not limited. If an IP is specified without a subnet mask, the default value is 32 for IPv4 and 128 for IPv6.

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: The name of the K8s cluster.

options.name: k8s_cluster
options.description: The ID or name of the K8s cluster.

options.name: k8s_version
options.description: The Kubernetes version that the cluster is running. This limits which Kubernetes versions can run in a cluster's node pools. Also, not all Kubernetes versions are suitable upgrade targets for all earlier versions.

options.name: location
options.description: This attribute is mandatory if the cluster is private and optional if the cluster is public. The location must be enabled for your contract, or you must have a data center at that location. This property is not adjustable.

options.name: maintenance_window
options.description: The maintenance window is used to update the control plane and the K8s version of the cluster. If no value is specified, it is chosen dynamically, so there is no fixed default value.

options.name: nat_gateway_ip
options.description: The nat gateway IP of the cluster if the cluster is private. This property is immutable. Must be a reserved IP in the same location as the cluster's location. This attribute is mandatory if the cluster is private.

options.name: node_subnet
options.description: The node subnet of the cluster, if the cluster is private. This property is optional and immutable. Must be a valid CIDR notation for an IPv4 network prefix of 16 bits length.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: public
options.description: The indicator whether the cluster is public or private. Note that the status FALSE is still in the beta phase.

options.name: s3_buckets_param
options.description: List of Object storage buckets configured for K8s usage. At the moment, it contains only one bucket that is used to store K8s API audit logs.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
